scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:tss-tools
scripts.test:tss-tools: node dist/tss-tools/lib/committeeTopology.test.js && node dist/tss-tools/lib/channelId.test.js && node dist/tss-tools/lib/keygenCeremony.test.js && node dist/scripts/tss-connectivity-check.test.js && node dist/scripts/tss-regroup-connectivity-check.test.js && node dist/tss-tools/lib/regroupCeremony.test.js && node dist/tss-tools/lib/tssPartyDefaults.test.js && node dist/tss-tools/lib/bnbTss.test.js && bash ./tss-tools/setup-mise-go.test.sh
scripts.start-tss: npm run compile && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
scripts.restart-tss: npm run compile && pm2 restart ecosystem.config.js
scripts.restart-tss:observers: npm run compile && pm2 restart $(node -e "const {apps}=require('./ecosystem.config.js'); process.stdout.write(apps.filter(app => app.name.startsWith('observer-')).map(app => app.name).join(' '))")
scripts.restart-tss:tss-parties: npm run compile && pm2 restart $(node -e "const {apps}=require('./ecosystem.config.js'); process.stdout.write(apps.filter(app => app.name.startsWith('tss-party-')).map(app => app.name).join(' '))")
scripts.flush-tss: pm2 stop ecosystem.config.js && pm2 delete ecosystem.config.js && rm -f ./logs/*.log && pm2 flush
